clues.text: Standing 131 feet tall, this coaster hits speeds up to 59 mph and turns riders upside down through 3 inversions.
This modern steel coaster was manufactured by Vekoma and made its public debut in 2022.
Thrill-seekers can find this attraction nestled in the coastal forests of Denmark.
This coaster made international headlines by introducing the world's first 'stall loop' element alongside 14 moments of airtime.
The attraction shares its name with the Danish word for a legendary mythical bird known for rising from its own ashes.

evidence.quote: Fønix ("Phoenix" in English) is a steel roller coaster at Fårup Sommerland in Blokhus, North Jutland, Denmark.
Fønix was designed and manufactured by Vekoma, and features 3 inversions - including the world's first "stall loop" element - as well as 14 airtime moments.
Using park teasers, fans eventually determined the name of the new coaster to be Fønix (Danish for "Phoenix").
